headline: Approved $100,000.00 generator design task order at 557 Pleasant Street and a natural gas supply contract with NRG, plus a $3,373.90 Malden Police detail payment.
summary: Approved a three-year natural gas supply contract with NRG and a task order of up to $100,000.00 for design work on a replacement emergency generator at 557 Pleasant Street. Also approved a three-year extension of the Executive Director's contract, the FY2027 budget, and a Gordon Griffith LLC fee accountant engagement letter. Approved payments included $351,125.28 for health insurance, $14,399.30 for resident service coordinators, and $7,066.24 for YMCA after-school programs.
decisions: Elected new officers, with Frank M. Molis as Chair and Joan M. Chiasson as Vice Chair, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved the minutes of the 9-22-26 and 9-29-26 meetings, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved bills and check signing for Section 8, MRVP, and the Revolving Fund Register for September 2026, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved Resolution 2026-13, the FY2027 EOHLC Budget, including the Executive Director's salary of $190,963.00, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved Resolution 2026-14, a three-year extension of Stephen G. Finn's contract as Executive Director at a salary of $190,963.00, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved Resolution 2026-15, certification and completion of forms for the CY2027 Operating Fund Grant application, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved Resolution 2026-16, certification and completion of forms for the CY2027 Operating Fund, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved payment of $351,125.28 to the Massachusetts Group Insurance Commission for FY2027 Quarter 1 health insurance, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved payment of $14,399.30 to Mystic Valley Aging Services for resident service coordinators for August 2026, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved payment of $7,066.24 to the YMCA for after-school programs, by a vote of 2-0 with one abstention from Frank M. Molis.

Approved the Executive Director to contract with NRG for natural gas supply at an approximate cost of $4.901/MMBTU for a three-year term from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2029, subject to final pricing, by a vote of 3-0.

Approved the Executive Director signing a task order contract with Michael Kim Architecture LLC for up to $100,000.00 for design work on a replacement emergency generator at 557 Pleasant Street, by a vote of 3-0.
Approved payment of six invoices to the Malden Police Department totaling $3,373.90 for detail coverage at various MHA developments, by a vote of 3-0.

Approved the Executive Director signing a fee accountant engagement letter with Gordon Griffith LLC for October 1, 2026 through September 2027, at $9,900.00 per month, increasing to $10,800.00 per month, by a vote of 3-0.

10/13/26

# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on October 13, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of the Authority, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148.

COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, and Karin H. Nystrom

COMMISSIONERS ABSENT: William P. Hurley and Emmanuel Marsh

MHA STAFF ATTENDING: Stephen G. Finn, Thomas P. Callaghan and Barbara A. Hooley

## 1. BOARD OFFICER ELECTION

The Board considered the election of the new offices, effective October 13, 2026.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To elect the new Board Officers as follows:

Frank M. Molis, Chair
Joan M. Chiasson, Vice Chair
Emmanuel Marsh, Secretary
Karin H. Nystrom, Treasurer
William P. Hurley, Assistant Treasurer

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

## 2. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 9-22-26 and 9-29-26

The Board reviewed the minutes of the 9-22-26 and 9-29-26 meeting.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the 9-22-26 and 9-29-26 meeting minutes.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

## 3. APPROVAL OF THE BILLS AND SIGNING OF CHECKS September 2026

a) The Board perused the Section 8 and MRVP Rent Payment Register for September, 2026 totaling $1,605,633.89 and the Revolving Fund Register for September, 2026 totaling $858,443.98.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for September, 2026.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

## 4. FINANCIAL MATTERS

### A. MHA FY2026 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR PERIOD ENDING JULY 31, 2026-(Review only)

### B. FY2027 HUD BUDGET--RESOLUTION 2026-13

The Board studied MHA's FY2027 EOHLC Budget inclusive of the Executive Director's approved salary of $190,963.00 as prepared pursuant to EOHLC's published FY2027 Budget Guidelines with further authorization and approval for the Board Chairperson, all Commissioners, the Executive Director and MHA's Fee Accountant to complete, sign and submit the budget with all requisite duly authorized budget certifications and documentation for the 400-1, Massachusetts Rental Voucher Program ("MRVP") and 689-C, State Housing Programs, inclusive of the completed Executive Director's Salary Calculation Worksheet at the Board approved salary of $190,063.00 and attach a true and accurate copy of the proposed contract of employment between MHA and the Executive Director fully reporting the Executive Director's total compensation to EOHLC through CapHub.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

RESOLVED AND VOTED: To approve MHA's FY2027 EOHLC Budget inclusive of the Executive Director's approved salary of $190,963.00 as prepared pursuant to EOHLC's published FY2027 Budget Guidelines with further authorization and approval for the Board Chairperson, all Commissioners, the Executive Director and MHA's Fee Accountant to complete, sign and submit the budget with all requisite duly authorized budget certifications and documentation for the 400-1, Massachusetts Rental Voucher Program ("MRVP") and 689-C State Housing Programs, inclusive of the completed Executive Director's Salary Calculation Worksheet at the Board approved salary of $190,063.00 and attach a true and accurate copy of the proposed contract of employment between MHA and the Executive Director fully reporting the Executive Director's total compensation to EOHLC through CapHub.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### C. FY2027 EXECUTIVE DIRECTORS SALARY--RESOLUTION 2026-14

The Board assessed approval of a three (3) year extension to the contract of employment between the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) and Stephen G. Finn, as Executive Director, that expired on September 30, 2026, at a salary in the amount of $190,963.00 as included on EOHLC's Executive Director's Salary Calculation Worksheet, requiring working 37.5 hours/week for each week worked during the contract term with sick-leave and vacation accrual and buy-backs in accordance with applicable EOHLC NAGE contract provisions and/or with all terms otherwise comporting with EOHLC's standard Executive Director contract, cover sheet and applicable Public Housing Notices, particularly Notices 2022-02 and 2023-06, for up to three (3) consecutive fiscal years (FY2027, FY2028 and FY2029) with the Board Chairperson and Treasurer authorized to sign the contract and with the Board Chair also to sign the cover sheet with the contract, and all else required thereafter submitted to EOHLC for review and approval.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

RESOLVED AND VOTED: To approve a three (3) year extension to the contract of employment between the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) and Stephen G. Finn, as Executive Director, that expired on September 30, 2026, at a salary in the amount of $190,963.00 as included on EOHLC's Executive Director's Salary Calculation Worksheet, requiring working 37.5 hours/week for each week worked during the contract term with sick-leave and vacation accrual and buy-backs in accordance with applicable EOHLC NAGE contract provisions and/or with all terms otherwise comporting with EOHLC's standard Executive Director contract, cover sheet and applicable Public Housing Notices, particularly Notices 2022-02 and 2023-06, for up to three (3) consecutive fiscal years (FY2027, FY2028 and Fy2029) with the Board Chairperson and Treasurer authorized to sign the contract and with the Board Chair also to sign the cover Sheet with the contract, and all else required thereafter submitted to EOHLC for review and approval.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### D. CY2027 OPERATING FUND GRANT--RESOLUTION 2026--15

The Board analyzed the forms SF-424, HUD 50071 and any other form required to finalize MHA's CY2027 Operating Fund Grant application submission in HUD's Public Housing Portal.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the certification, authorization and approval of completion of forms SF-424, HUD 50071 and any other form required to finalize MHA's CY2027 Operating Fund Grant Application submission in HUD's Public Housing Portal.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### E. CY2027 OPERATING FUND--RESOLUTION 2026--16

The Board examined the forms HUD 52722 and HUD 52753 and any other form required to finalize MHA's CY2027 Operating Fund Grant application electronic submission in HUD's Public Housing Portal.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the certification, authorization and approval of completion of forms SF-424, HUD 50071 and any other form required to finalize MHA's CY2027 Operating Fund Grant application submission in HUD's Public Housing Portal.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### F. MASSACHUSETTS GROUP INSURANCE COMMISSION (GIC)--Invoice

The Board evaluated three (3) invoices dated 09/25/2026 from the GIC as detailed below for the first quarter of FY2027 health insurance with cost to be paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

| GIC Program | Amount |
|---|---|
| Current Employees | $266,043.35 |
| Retired Employees | $79,688.89 |
| Survivor Benefits | $5,393.04 |
| Total | $351,125.28 |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment in the amount $351,125.28 to the GIC for FY2027 Quarter 1 health insurance with cost to be determined as allocated by the Finance Director.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

### G. MYSTIC VALLEY AGING SERVICES (MVAS)--Invoice

The Board studied an invoice dated 10/02/2026 in the amount of $14,399.30 from MVAS for onsite Resident Service Coordinators for the month of August, 2026 with cost paid by the AMP's served

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson, and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $14,399.30 to MVAS for Resident Service Coordinators for the month of August, 2026 with cost paid by the AMP's served.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### H. YMCA--Invoices--Two (2)

The Board studied two (2) invoices from the YMCA as follows:

| Program | Date | Amount | Amp Charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linden After School Program-August | 8-31-26 | $3,550.25 | 1 |
| Newland After School Program-August | 8-31-26 | $3,515.99 | 1 |
| **Total** | | **$7,066.24** | **1** |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment in the amount in the amount of $7,066.24 to the YMCA as detailed above.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

Abstain: Frank M. Molis

### I. VEOLIA ENERGY MANAGEMENT--Contract

The Board assessed the recommendation of MHA's procured Utility Supply Agent, Veolia Energy Management, to contract with NRG Business Marketing LLC (NRG) for natural gas supply at an approximate cost of $4.901/MMBTU for a three (3) year term beginning January 1, 2027 and ending on December 31, 2029 with cost to be paid as allocated by the Finance Director, subject to final pricing.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize Executive Director to contract with NRG for natural gas supply at an approximate cost of $4.901/MMBTU for a three (3) year term beginning January 1, 2027 and ending on December 31, 2029 with cost to be paid as allocated by the Finance Director, subject to final pricing.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

### J. MICHAEL KIM ARCHITECTURE, LLC--Task Order

The Board considered a task order with Michael Kim Architecture LLC in the amount of up to $100,000.00 for design engineering on the acquisition, permitting and installation of a replacement emergency generator in accordance with code and regulation at 557 Pleasant Street with cost to be paid by AMP 5 and Operating Reserves if necessary.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize the Executive Director to sign a task order contract with Michael Kim Architecture LLC in the amount of up to $100,000.00 for design engineering on the acquisition, permitting and installation of a replacement emergency generator in accordance with code and regulation at 557 Pleasant Street with cost to be paid by AMP 5 and Operating Reserves if necessary.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

VOTED: To approve and authorize payment of six (6) invoices to the Malden Police Department with a total cost of $3,373.90 for detail coverage at various MHA developments with cost to be allocated to the AMP's served.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### L. GORDON AND GRIFFIN, LLC--Engagement Letter

The Board perused an Engagement Letter from Gordon Griffith LLC for the provision of annual Fee Accountant services for the period October 1, 2026 through September 2027 at the monthly cost of $9,900.00/month, with a 2 percent increase starting February 2027 to $10,800.00/month through September 2027 with cost to be paid as determined by the Finance Director.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson, and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize Executive Director to sign FY2027 Engagement Letter from Gordon Griffith LLC for the provision of annual Fee Accountant services for the period October 1, 2026, through September 2027 at the monthly cost of $9,900.00/month, increasing to $10,800.00/ month effective through September 2027 with cost to be paid as determined by the Finance Director.

Ayes: Frank M. Molis, Joan M. Chiasson and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None
